texts.preamble: Globe Impex & Anr vs Commissioner Of Customs on 22 September, 2025 Author: Prathiba M. Singh Bench: Prathiba M. Singh $~78 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi + Cusaa 6/2024 & Cm Appl. 60407/20 Globe Impex & Anr. Through: Mr versus Commissioner Of Customs .....Respo Through: Mr. R. Ramachandran & Mr. Pr Dhir, Advs. Coram: Justice Prathiba M. Singh Justice Shail Jain Order % 22.09.2025 1.
texts.facts: This hearing has been done through hybrid mode. 2. This is a fresh application filed by the Appellants seeking release of the goods for the Petitioner unconditionally for the purpose of industrial use. 3. Reliance is placed upon the order passed by this Court in W.P.(C) 16560/2024 titled M/s Perfect Trading Co v. Commissioner of Customs & Ors.
texts.arguments: Further, Supreme Court in M/s CRANE BETEL NUT POWDER WORKS versus COMMR. OF CUS. & C. EX. TIRUPATHI Globe Impex & Anr vs Commissioner Of Customs on 22 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/140682857/ 1 reported in 2007 (210) E.L.7T. 171 (S.C.)., Chennai and in the case of M/s Azam Laminators Pvt. Ltd. (where scented betel nut was being manufactured by cracking of dried betel nut into small pieces, and thereafter gently heating it with addition of vanaspati oil, sweetening and flavoring agents and marketed in small pouches as Nizam Pakku (in Tamil)/Betel Nut (in English), the Hon'ble CESTAT held the resultant product classifiable under sub-heading 0802.9019 of Central Excise Tariff and not under 21069030 as supari for period after 07.07.2009 are relevant.
